title: Integrated Load Forecasting and Anomaly-Gated Supervisory Replay for Building Energy Management — R2 reproducibility package
description: Complete R2 numerical reproduction software/data: frozen benchmark, pinned BDG2 inputs, trained states, validation learning curves, predictions, calibration and prospective supervisory replay, paired uncertainty and verifiers. Software is MIT, author synthetic data/documentation are CC BY 4.0 where granted, and BDG2 inputs/derivatives retain their separate upstream Attribution-ShareAlike terms and source attribution. See the component license files; Other (Open) denotes this mixed-license collection and does not replace any component license. Journal correspondence and document-only assembly files are omitted. Scientific results remain unchanged.
